limitations: Baseline and hybrid measurements were collected on different days on a shared machine, not a reserved CPU. Small timing differences may be noise.
The comparison includes Geometry kernel unification and build-standard differences (native C++11, hybrid C++20); it does not isolate the external solver.

Repeated zero-Q model evaluations, three serial blocks of 25 calls after two untimed priming calls. Model/graph creation excluded. Native warm seeds reused; CasADi callbacks are cold. Not a motion-cycle benchmark.
Independent reference length tolerance 1e-9 m; velocity = J*Qdot tolerance 1e-10. Contact transitions remain piecewise smooth; no global minimum claim.
